Vicon Creator · On-location photography

Photographer in The Hague / Den Haag

In The Hague, the first choice is often between a city setting and the coast. For a love story, maternity portrait or family photoshoot, that choice changes the walking, clothing and pace. Vicon Creator offers sessions in Den Haag by arrangement, with the same cinematic approach throughout.

Beach, dunes or city

Scheveningen and Kijkduin offer a coastal setting; the dune landscapes around The Hague give a different texture from city streets. Sand and wind become part of the photographs. A city route may suit you better if you prefer firmer paths, layered architecture or less exposure. Location access and any permissions are checked before confirming a plan.

Comfort for maternity and family sessions

Choose the amount of walking before choosing the view. Tell me if you would like a short route, sitting breaks or somewhere close to the meeting point. For maternity portraits, decide whether you want to be photographed alone or with a partner. For children, clothing that works in the actual weather is more useful than an outfit chosen only for its colour.

Light and a weather alternative

Warm evening light is one possible mood, not a booking guarantee. Cloud, wind and the season may suggest a different time or backdrop. Agree a sheltered alternative and when a decision will be made. Indoor hire, travel and any change of date need to be discussed in the proposal.

Location background: Den Haag: dunes. Access and any permissions are confirmed for the proposed session.
